# Floor <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Floor:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | The number to round down. |

**Returns:** The largest whole number that is not above `float`.

## Description

Rounds down to the previous whole number and returns it as a float.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Floor(2.9)
Print Floor(-2.1)
```

```text
2.0
-3.0
```
